hotel.name: The Westin Grand Cayman Seven Mile Beach Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on 700 feet of white sand on Seven Mile Beach, among tropical palms and casuarina trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled among tropical palms and casuarina trees and situated on 700 feet of the most pristine white sand of the famous Seven Mile Beach

verified_facts.text: The freshwater pool, next to the beach, is the largest on the island.
verified_facts.excerpt: The largest on the island, our freshwater pool is situated right next to the beach.

verified_facts.text: The pool has a swim-up bar with submerged bar stools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a refreshing drink without leaving the water at our swim-up bar in Grand Cayman, featuring submerged bar stools

verified_facts.text: Beach and pool cabanas are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy your own private retreat with our beach or pool cabana.

verified_facts.text: The Hibiscus Spa has thirteen treatment rooms, two steam and sauna rooms, a women's whirlpool and Vichy showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 7,000 square feet facility offering thirteen treatment rooms, two steam and sauna rooms, women’s whirlpool and vichy showers

verified_facts.text: The Hibiscus Spa's treatments are inspired by the ocean, lush landscapes and the island's natural beauty.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Hibiscus Spa offers a serene, elevated wellness experience inspired by the ocean, lush landscapes, and natural beauty of the island.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Ocean Front rooms sit directly on Seven Mile Beach with unobstructed ocean views; ground-level rooms have patios and second-floor rooms have balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Deluxe Ocean Front rooms are located directly on Seven Mile Beach. They offer an unobstructed view of the ocean in Grand Cayman. The ground level hotel rooms feature patios and the 2nd floor rooms carry balconies.

verified_facts.text: Room design is inspired by an abstract interpretation of the ocean, with local Caymanian flair.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our inspirations for design began with an abstract interpretation of the ocean

verified_facts.text: Toes in the Sand by Beach House offers private tables on Seven Mile Beach overlooking the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your Grand Cayman dining experience with a private table on Seven Mile Beach, overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

verified_facts.text: Woto serves chef-prepared sushi, ceviche and poke.
verified_facts.excerpt: This all-day dining destination features an island-inspired menu with chef-prepared sushi, ceviche, and poke.

verified_facts.text: Activities include sunrise beach yoga, paddleboard clinics and evening s'mores by the fire.
verified_facts.excerpt: From sunrise beach yoga and paddleboard clinics to evening s’mores by the fire, there’s something for everyone.

verified_facts.text: Red Sail Sports offers water-based adventures on site.
verified_facts.excerpt: On-site, Red Sail Sports offers water-based adventures steps from your door.

verified_facts.text: Family activities include family game nights and kids' scavenger hunts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy morning meditation, family game nights, water fitness classes, and exciting kids’ scavenger hunts.

verified_facts.text: The pool area has two hot tubs and is a spot to watch the Cayman sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy the relaxation of two hot tubs, poolside courtyard café and pool bar with swim-up bar.

verified_facts.text: The resort is minutes from the airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our central location, just minutes from the airport, makes travel seamless.

verified_facts.text: Seven Mile Beach water averages 80F (27C) in winter.
verified_facts.excerpt: With water temperatures averaging a warm 80°F (27°C) in winter

verified_facts.text: The Westin Workout Fitness Studio is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: energize yourself in our 24-hour Westin Workout® Fitness Studio

verified_facts.text: Some activities require a 24-hour sign-up or carry an additional fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some activities may require a 24-hour sign-up or carry an additional fee

unresolved.text: The resort has been named to Conde Nast Traveler's Gold List.
